##### Project general facts

Nesba 3 by Arada is a contemporary residential building designed to accommodate a broad spectrum of lifestyles, from young professionals to growing families. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors, with a modern facade, generous glazing and balconies that create a seamless connection between the interiors and the outdoors. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two- and three-bedroom family homes with practical, well-proportioned layouts and plenty of natural light.

A swimming pool and a fully equipped gym support a balanced and healthy routine, while outdoor walking areas and landscaped communal spaces invite residents to relax, exercise and meet neighbours. The flagship sports complex of the community, with football pitches and courts for padel, basketball, volleyball and badminton, is close by, and essential services, cafes and shops sit within a short stroll of the building for everyday convenience.

Every residence integrates smart home technology, allowing residents to control lighting, climate and security with ease. Kitchens are fitted with a premium European cooker, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer, while modern finishes and high-quality materials create an elegant, practical backdrop for everyday life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens only, leaving furniture and decor entirely to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, schools, hotels, retail and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with parks, a skate park, a drive-in cinema and a wide choice of restaurants, while landscaped green corridors and shaded walkways link the residential neighbourhoods with shops, cafes and community services.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar and City Centre Al Zahia are a short drive away, University City and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
